wear_count: Count distinct non-voided wear_confirmed source events; not planned/saved/liked/tryon
wear_days: Distinct Asia/Seoul local dates of those events; one event spanning midnight counts by declared occurred_at date unless app explicitly captures interval semantics
wash_window: Only wash_completed sets last_wash; ironing/airing/drying do not
professional_cleaning: Keep separate from wash counter; any combined cleaning counter must be explicitly named and tested
no_baseline: after_last_wash is null without a recorded wash; never infer 0 wears since purchase
observation_age: Show observed_at or last_known; no invented freshness threshold
calendar: planned -> scheduled_at; wear/care -> occurred_at; card_created_at is neither
latest_record: Use as_of and non-voided events; recorded future plans are allowed, future observations excluded
care_temperature: Do not convert cool/cold/medium iron to a numeric value absent source
time_fixture: Freeze context clock only within this demo namespace; do not change production clock or silently shift history each run
claim_sources: Value must retain source_ref or event_ref; narrative not a new evidence source
import_idempotency: namespace+entity_type+source_ref/source_event_key; changed payload on same key yields review conflict, not silent overwrite
user_action_idempotency: actor+action+intent_key, with per-action draft revision uniqueness; save card vs plan today remain distinct intents
ownership: Product code is not a garment instance. H01 and S02 intentionally share P01 but are separate demo objects
display_mirrors: Existing transparency, horizontal navigation, stable action positions, snapshot continuity preserved
